items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Mr. Black, Duwell Black called me yesterday

ctx.x: Wanted to say hello to Pete. Couldn't stand hearing everybody else say hello to him out of the old days, but wondered with you and Pete together tonight if you would tell us a little bit about what plans are underway for the jazz festival, if any, coming this summer.

Well, Mr. Black, Duwell Black called me yesterday, and I haven't heard anything about who's coming on or whether we're going to play it or how or why or where. Are we going to have it? Oh, I think so. I don't think they should let it go.
I don't think any of us think it, but we're hoping that it won't be let go. And, Doug, I know you were pretty instrumental last year, too, weren't you?
